title: Standard hooks for stirrup and tie anchorage
statement:
Standard hooks in case of stirrup and tie anchorage: (c)(i) if the diameter of stirrup or tie bar is 16 mm or smaller, the hooks shall have a $90^{\circ}$ bend plus an extension of at least 6 bar diameters at the free end of the bar
Standard hooks in case of stirrup and tie anchorage: (c)(ii) if the diameter of stirrup or tie bar is between 19 mm to 25 mm, the hooks shall have a $90^{\circ}$ bend plus an extension of at least 12 bar diameters at the free end of the bar
Standard hooks in case of stirrup and tie anchorage: (c)(iii) if the diameter of stirrup or tie bar is 25 mm or larger, the hooks shall have a $135^{\circ}$ bend plus an extension of at least 6 bar diameters at the free end of the bar
Standard hooks in case of stirrup and tie anchorage: (c)(iv) For closed ties and continuously wound ties, the hooks shall have a $135^{\circ}$ bend plus an extension of at least 6 bar diameters, but not less than 75 mm.
scope_note: Covers clause (c)(i)-(iv): hooks used for stirrup and tie anchorage, which have their own extension rules. Clause (d) (seismic hooks) is out of scope.
